title: Park-View Townhome, 6 Beds, 6 Min to BNA Airport
description:
Take advantage of 6 beds in this spacious townhome only 6min from the airport & 15min from Downtown Nashville, Broadway, & more! The unit features 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a private garage & floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a park.

HIGHLIGHTS
- 6 Beds
- Kitchen & Bathroom Essentials
- Private Garage
- Washer & Dryer w/ Tide Pods
- Free WiFi
- Bag Drop Off, Early Check-In & Late Check-Out Options
- Smart Lock w/ Unique Access Code

The space
LEVEL ONE
The first floor features a guest bedroom with a queen bed and full bathroom.

LEVEL TWO
The second floor features a kitchen, living room, full bathroom, and a bedroom with a queen bed. There is no formal dining area, but the kitchen offers a breakfast bar for casual meals.

LEVEL THREE
The third level features two bedrooms each featuring two full beds (4 full beds total). Each bedroom has its own ensuite bathroom. Additionally, there is laundry room on this floor.

PARKING
The attached garage can accommodate two vehicles. We do not provide a garage door opener or shovel snow.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home except for a locked owner's closet. They'll receive a four-digit access code before arrival to enter the unit through our Schlage Encode smart lock. Additionally, there will be an onsite lockbox accessible in case of a smart lock failure. We provide 24/7 customer support to ensure you never get locked out. We also enhance property security with a Ring doorbell.

Other things to note
We are the following minutes away from these destinations by car:
- 15 minutes from Broadway, Ryman Auditorium, Nissan Stadium & Bridgestone Arena
- 12 minutes from Grand Ole Opry & Opry Mills Mall
- 6 minutes from the Nashville International Airport (BNA)
- 15 minutes from Geodis Park (Home to Nashville SC)
- 16 minutes from Belmont University
- 16 minutes from Vanderbilt University
